title: The reeve's Barrow Doors quest ('the priest will not bless a door meant to shut') implies the priest's blessing is conditional on the doors staying open, but this is never reconciled with a blessing you may have already banked earlier — the game doesn't say whether promising the reeve retroactively cancels it.
